summary: The recorded base reproduced the unknown-tool streaming corruption. The exact candidate preserved both valid calls, stable indices, valid JSON arguments, and empty normal text across all six affected detectors and independent chunk/order boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Original and adversarial streaming contract; 106 failures among 108 cases reproduced the defect.
108/108 cases passed across JsonArray, Qwen2.5, Hermes, Llama3.2, Mistral, and Trinity with varied ordering and chunking.
Complete function-call suite: 556 passed, 21 subtests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reported contract and candidate changes are pure-Python request parsing; no GPU or model is required.

remaining_limitations: No HTTP serving, model weights, semantic model behavior, architecture-specific inference, GPU execution, or distributed workload was tested; none is required to verify this parser-only issue.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source and the prepared environment declares no native artifact.
